comparison: Compared with parent t1-coupling-v1 (readout-e770044794f0c855f4331e16), gating conformal local horizons on patch-smoothed real width heterogeneity g_width(Y), gating chart routing on (1 - g_conn), and restoring polar_cpu_v1 resolved all three targeted regressions (two_pole, model_vae_hard, interp_sparse_arc) plus nvfp4. However, lowering the in-basin cross-chart rebalancing deadband from 2.0 SE to 1.15 SE (25% false-positive rate) caused single-step cross-mode slot swaps on encoder-coupled models after convergence (ae_gan_hold hold=0.0006 at step 230 -> recon_mse=1.3706 spike at step 240 -> 0.0105 at step 250; model_vae_categorical mass_tv blip at step 1100).
conclusion: Completed Tier 1 discriminator_stability seed-0 CUDA execution for t1-coupling-v2 (14/16 Tier 1 PASS: converted two_pole to PASS grad_med=0.1172, model_vae_hard to PASS, interp_sparse_arc to PASS interp_hq=0.8116, and precision_gaussian_nvfp4 to PASS alongside mxfp8, ring16_acquisition, five_word_joint_smoke, and clockfree_audit_measurement_v1; 2/11 required Tier 1 FAIL on ae_gan_hold and model_vae_categorical with 0.0 live shortfall but passing_suffix 1/5 and 2/5).

decision_outcomes.reuse_note: Compatible original receipts; overlapping readouts are not independent runs or additive costs

hypothesis: Gating conformal local horizons on patch-smoothed real width heterogeneity g_width(Y), gating quota-capped Laguerre chart commitment and exact FP32 activation-gram gradient deconfliction on topological disconnectedness w_valley * (1 - g_conn(Y)) with strictly intra-mode halos r_halo <= min(1.65 * r_k, 0.35 * d_nn_chart), and restoring polar_cpu_v1 on small dense layers resolves all Tier 1 regressions from t1-coupling-v1 (two_pole, ae_gan_hold, model_vae_hard, interp_sparse_arc) while improving disconnected-mode coverage and multi-scale accuracy across Tier 2-3 (img_bars4, vector_unequal_width, grid100, model_ddgan_gaussian_chain) at 3x+ faster high-res conv throughput than rhbi-v12.
next_action: Advance to bounded revision t1-coupling-v3: raise the in-basin cross-chart rebalancing threshold to 2.8 SE (>99% confidence, keeping genuine 4-6 SE mode-collapse rebalancing active while eliminating multinomial slot-swap false alarms) and gate in-basin cross-chart pulls by thermal disequilibrium s_thermal.

study.competing_explanation: Quota-capped Laguerre Monge commitment (t1c_chart_weight=1.0, t1c_halo_mult=1.65) or disconnected-gated activation-gram whitened polar updates (t1c_grad_deconflict=0.5) could still induce intra-mode covariance shrinkage on anisotropic clouds (vector_anisotropic), or width-heterogeneity conformal horizons (t1c_multiscale_horizon=true) could trade off against rare-mode support completion on vector_unequal_mass relative to rhbi-v12.
